matches.rationale: Finding 2 identifies that Assumption 3.2 states the conditional distribution is N(mu_p, Sigma_p) but the appendix incorrectly assumes N(0, Sigma_p), and that Definition 3.3 uses an unconditional mean instead of the conditional mean. This directly detects the ground truth defect about the invalid/ambiguous conditional Gaussian assumption, pointing to the same material (Assumption 3.2, Definition 3.3, Appendix A.2) and the same inconsistency in how the conditional distribution is specified.

Finding 1 demonstrates that the claimed polynomial inequality in Theorem 3.5 (2/pi^2 L_flow^2 <= L_A <= 4/pi^2 L_flow^2) is mathematically invalid for high-dimensional fields, showing the upper bound fails via counterexample. This detects the ground truth defect that Theorem 3.5 incorrectly assumes full equality/tight control between objectives while ignoring practical deviations. The finding shows the strict guarantee is overoptimistic by proving it mathematically false.
